title: Calculate Your Real Principal — in 4 Steps
sub: Your strongest number in any settlement talk.

heading: 4 steps
steps: Download all statements since the card was opened (or last 2–3 years)
Add up every purchase and cash withdrawal
Subtract every payment and refund you made
What's left = your principal (no interest, fees or GST)

heading: Example
tag: Negotiate from ₹85,000 — not from their total

items.text: Missing statements? Ask the bank by e-mail — they must give them
Keep the calculation on one page — show it in every negotiation
Open with a number near your principal, not their total
